title: At San Clemente, Murād's army of 6,250 destroys the last Castilian field army, 950 men under Ibn al-Khaṭīb, the renegade vizier. 840 of them are killed and 105 taken, for 31 of ours
Morocco makes nine of its new towns on the Strait into a fiefdom under the old rebel name, the 'Kingdom of Sevilla', though Ishbīliyya itself is Granada's. Fās keeps Ronda and Marbella for itself

Peace with Castile. Granada declares its independence, and Castile gives up the land of Niebla and Huelva, six towns from Ayamonte, where Yūsuf died, to Aracena. It also pays a sum into the treasury and owes reparations for ten years. The War of Independence is over

data.gameGlitch: The game put Granada back under Castile as a tributary after the peace; Trent will remove that with the console

source: save of 5 April 1366 (after the peace); Trent's account

title: At the peace the realm holds 62 towns and 732,000 people, 61 of the 72 towns of the Strait's three lands with its ṭāʾifas. The treasury stands at 1,131, with Portugal, Aragon and Castile all paying reparations
